decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will and disruption spells like Daze. The deck aims to win the game through a powerful combo of reanimating creatures and out-valuing the opponent.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to bring them back into play for a quick win. It also includes countermagic like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, as well as disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. Additionally, it has card advantage and selection tools like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to find the necessary pieces. It also includes a small control package with cards like Brazen Borrower and Cling to Dust to deal with threats or disrupt opponents' strategies.

The deck also makes use of land and artifact tutors to find necessary pieces to maintain its aggressive strategy.
